K4 (country-specific investment property fair value developments) and K7 (sustainability performance) are MISSING entirely. The summary captures most core financial and operational metrics but lacks detailed geographic property value breakdowns and sustainability performance data, resulting in a Generally yes rating (score 3).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements are consistent with each other and follow logical relationships. Explanations of performance drivers, financial metrics, and risk indicators are clear and well-organized. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a coherent whole that logically progresses from operational performance to financial results and risk indicators. The differences between segment figures and consolidated totals (e.g., rental income stability vs. stronger performance) are explained by listed factors without implying contradictions. All relationships between figures (e.g., NOI margin improvement, profit increases) are logically supported by the stated drivers.
